page.overview:
Who is Dewey?

Dewey is one of the Dewdrops that has to be tormented by the Root Monster. He is the main sidekick and tormented friend of Finn and Jake in the unproduced episode "Brothers in Insomnia." He is the one to tell Finn and Jake about the Root Monster.

Brothers in Insomnia was later remade into "Little Brother," where Dewey was called Leaf Beard.
